question: How do I prevent it (Mastitis)
output: Use a separate clean towel for each cow, clean the milking equipment after milking an infected cow, and give cows clean, dry bedding. [KB-225-LM] Ask your vet about dry cow therapy at the end of lactation; a quarter that keeps getting mastitis may need to be dried off. [KB-227-LM]

question: What can I do for it at home (Ringworm)
output: Wear gloves when handling affected animals and wash your hands afterwards, because ringworm can infect people. [KB-235-LM] Brush off crusts carefully, then throw away the brush and burn the crusts, because they spread the fungus. Do not use bleach on the skin. [KB-233-LM]
